nodes.description: Address with privileged control over delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping address=>uint holding token balances.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint of approvals.
Private mapping counting sales per address, used in condition().
Private whitelist mapping bypassing ensure() restrictions.

Private per-address sale count limit enforced by condition().
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses ensure() checks.
Public total token supply.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as whitelist in ensure().
Private balance mapping inside the ERC20 base contract.
Private nested allowance mapping inside the ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply inside the ERC20 base contract.
UniswapExchange constructor: mints supply, sets owner and infinite allowance to the router.
External payable transfer that forwards msg.sender into transferFrom.
Internal whitelist check granting free transfers to owner, UNI, pair and tradeAddress.
External payable transfer that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
External payable approval writer storing values under msg.sender without return guarantee.
Internal sale limit logic reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only sale parameter initializer using unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only batch transfer with unchecked arithmetic and callers' funds.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address for the token.
ERC20._transfer internal balance movement using SafeMath.
ERC20.transferFrom that decrements allowance for msg.sender.
SafeERC20 private helper performing a low-level call on the token address.
Context._msgSender returning msg.sender.
msg.sender, the only externally controlled primitive present in the source.
delegatecall to arbitrary address inside delegate(), executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
allowance and balanceOf debits in transferFrom performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf subtraction and total multiplication in batchSend without SafeMath.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn, returning control to an external contract.
token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) in init without SafeMath.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into the internal transferFrom call.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the allowance spender key.
approve writes allowance under msg.sender.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints supply to it.
delegate() authorizes on msg.sender == owner before delegatecall.
init() authorizes on msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
batchSend() authorizes on msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress() authorizes on msg.sender == owner before whitelisting.
ERC20._transfer is invoked with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20.transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance debit.
Context._msgSender simply returns msg.sender.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the whitelist check fails.
ensure() derives the pair address through pairFor().
ERC20.transferFrom performs the balance move through ERC20._transfer.
delegate() executes arbitrary external code via delegatecall in this contract's context.
callOptionalReturn makes a low-level call that hands control to an external token contract.
transferFrom decrements allowance and balanceOf with raw arithmetic.
batchSend computes total and subtracts balances with raw arithmetic.
init scales token amounts with raw multiplication.
Constructor sets the owner state variable.
Constructor assigns the entire supply in balanceOf.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the router address.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supply argument.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum for the sender.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner whitelist.
ensure consults canSale whitelist before restricting a transfer.
ensure whitelists the configured tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address.
condition reads _onSaleNum to enforce per-address caps.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition checks the global _saleNum limit.
approve writes into the allowance mapping.
delegate gates the delegatecall on the owner state variable.
init gates parameter updates on the owner state variable.
init writes the _minSale state variable.
init writes the _maxSale state variable.
init writes the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend gates balance movement on the owner state variable.
batchSend debits the sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
setTradeAddress gates the write on the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ERC20._transfer mutates the ERC20 _balances mapping.
ERC20.transferFrom decrements the ERC20 _allowances mapping.
ERC20.transferFrom indirectly moves balances through _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as the recipient argument of transfer().
_value is only used as the amount argument of transfer().
_from feeds the allowance and balance key lookups in transferFrom().
_to is the credit target inside transferFrom().
_value drives the unchecked allowance and balance math in transferFrom().
Target parameter a is the address of the unsafe delegatecall.
Payload parameter b is the calldata forwarded to the unsafe delegatecall.
_tos controls the recipient loop in batchSend().
_value is the multiplicand in the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
saleNum is directly assigned to the _saleNum state variable in init().
token is scaled by raw multiplication inside init().
maxToken is scaled by raw multiplication inside init().
addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
_from is checked against the ensure() whitelist.
_to is checked against the ensure() whitelist.
_value is forwarded from ensure() into condition().
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is range-checked against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
total is the unchecked product consumed by the batchSend balance debit.
_UNI is computed and consumed by the ensure() whitelist comparison.
i is the iteration variable of the batchSend transfer loop.
